title: The batch runner's blame runs one diff search per merge commit, so a red names the lane that caused it
why: Runner 8 blamed #1867 at 17:10 CST Nov 8 when #1774 was the cause, because two diff searches printed together (runner 8, 18:58 CST; via the coordinator 19:04 CST).
note: Filed by triage, Nov 8 19:04 CST. The coordinator routes it. Waits on the lane-inflow hold (coordinator 20:19 CST Nov 8, decision lane-inflow-hold): no new lane until batches 66 and 67 merge, except owner asks and queue-landing fixes.
